REVIEW FAIL (code): hosted-auth-guard-bypass-via-resolvePrincipal — FR-007, FR-010.
  WHERE: src/server/index.ts:664-738
  EXPECTED: Whenever `effectiveTransport === "hosted"`, `startServer` MUST unconditionally register `registerHostedAuthGuard` and default-deny `setNotFoundHandler`, wire `resolveVerifiedPrincipal` as the sole principal reader for all operational routes (`healthRoutes`, `statusRoutes`, `dispatchRoutes`, `notifyRoutes`) so a caller-supplied `options.resolvePrincipal` can NEVER bypass the guard or replace guard-established context, and unconditionally pass `transport: "hosted"` to `healthRoutes` so `/health` serves minimal private liveness and `/api/health` requires project authorization.
